args.subject: Resume Template
args.body:
Hi Alice,

I found the resume template download page at www.resume-templates.com and the download links at resume-templates-portal.com. However, I'm unable to download the PDF files directly due to system policy restrictions.

The download links I found are:
- https://www.resume-templates-portal.com/download_links/resume_template.pdf
- https://www.resume-templates-portal.com/download_links/resume_template_part2.pdf

You can try accessing these links directly, or let me know if there's another way I can help you get the template.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
